description:
Draw subtitles into the picture, so they show in every player. Needs an `FFmpeg` with the
`subtitles` filter (libass). Takes video files. Needs FFmpeg.

file.description: The subtitles: an SRT, VTT, ASS or SSA file in UTF-8.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

size.description:
The size of the letters, 1 to 200 (of a picture 288 lines high, whatever its real size).
An ASS file's own size when left out.

name: video_subtitles
title: Draw subtitles
